difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-comparison-fppf-etale at source lines 1144-1154: for a sheaf F on X_etale one has epsilon_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F = pi_X^{-1}F and a_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F = F, and for any abelian F one has R^i epsilon_{X,*}(a_X^{-1}F) = 0 for i > 0 (note that, unlike the ph statement, the author asks for no torsion hypothesis here). The author's proof at source lines 1156-1211 proves part (1) from the explicit description of pi_X^{-1} together with the fact that pi_X^{-1}F is already an fppf sheaf (the author's lemma-describe-pullback, retained as context), and proves part (2) by reduction to schemes: higher direct images of epsilon_{X,*} are the sheaves associated to U -> H^p_fppf(U,-), every object of the small etale site has a covering by schemes, the fppf cohomology over (Spaces/U)_fppf is identified with that over (Sch/U)_fppf (the author's lemma-compare-cohomology-other-topologies retained as context, plus a general restriction fact declared as a pointer), and the scheme statement (a cross-chapter pointer, used twice) kills the class on an etale covering. The author explicitly urges the reader to skip the proof of part (2); the remark is reproduced verbatim.
